limitations: All cases, identities and integrations are synthetic. No real outreach, payer approval or clinical authority.
Live synthesis and new semantic vectors require explicitly configured server credentials and request budgets. Missing or failed providers pause with no silent fallback.
Model support review is fallible. Exact quote and eligibility checks do not prove every paraphrase is entailed.
TXT, Markdown, PDF and DOCX parsing is bounded: 1 MB, 20 PDF pages, 64,000 extracted characters and 128 passages. No OCR; PDF tables can have uncertain reading order.
Content screening and user attestation do not guarantee patient-data detection. Temporary sandbox data expires with the session; approved published sources and governed evidence remain immutable.
Enterprise identity, real channel integrations, independent healthcare validation, production load, backup restoration and patient outcomes are unverified.
